promql_har_vs_coralogix_metrics.note: metrics__list in this account shows actual __name__ values. HAR/dashboard PromQL often does not match.

examples.note: Other Claude counters in metrics__list use suffixes like _1_total (e.g. claude_code_session_count_1_total) vs HAR without _1 — verify in Metrics Explorer.

gemini_cli_real_vs_sim.description: Parity checklist: real gemini-cli (Node) OTLP vs otel-ai-agent-sim.
gemini_cli_real_vs_sim.subsystem_filter_note: Live interactive CLI may use cx.subsystem.name gemini-cli-sessions-real; the sim defaults to gemini-cli-sessions for isolation.
gemini_cli_real_vs_sim.automated_validation: python scripts/validate_gemini_span_mcp.py (from repo root; project venv recommended)

batch_promql_note: har-queries-for-mcp-run.json lists 41 unique PromQL strings from HAR URLs. Many reference metric names that do not exist verbatim in Coralogix; run Metrics → list, then swap names before pasting into dashboards.

claude_code_new_shapes_dmbsm.description: Session/repo + prompt analysis telemetry (2026-06). Legacy dmbsm sim (job=otel-ai-agent-sim) lacks these until latest image is deployed.
legacy_present_in_dmbsm: flat OTLP logs: $l.subsystemname == 'claude-code', event_name user_prompt with prompt_length only (no prompt text)

new_shapes_after_deploy.metric: claude_code_session_repo_info{session_id,repository_name} — gauge 1 per session/repo; join to logs on session_id
